name: bash
arguments:
{"command":"python3 - <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
import csv, io
p='''record_id,regular_hours,overtime_hours,hourly_rate,deduction
EMP-001,159,7,31.19,202
EMP-002,145,6,27.4,165
EMP-003,158,7,42.76,168
EMP-004,130,9,23.1,138
EMP-005,144,4,23.06,173
EMP-006,148,9,40.39,174
EMP-007,154,10,32.54,138
EMP-008,150,2,36.51,231
EMP-009,156,8,45.9,191
EMP-010,143,6,32.84,207
'''
q=Decimal('.01'); mult=Decimal('1.73'); wh=Decimal('.2137')
tot=Decimal(0); tot2=Decimal(0)
for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(p)):
 d={k:Decimal(v) for k,v in r.items() if k!='record_id'}
 gross=d['regular_hours']*d['hourly_rate']+d['overtime_hours']*d['hourly_rate']*mult
 net=(gross*(1-wh)-d['deduction']).quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
 grosr=gross.quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
 net2=(grosr*(1-wh)-d['deduction']).quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
 print(r['record_id'],gross,grosr,net,net2)
 tot+=net;tot2+=net2
print('tot exact gross:',tot,'tot rounded gross:',tot2)
PY"}
